title: Teenage Seductress
writer: Chris Warfield, George 'Buck' Flower, John F. Goff
actors: Sondra Currie, Chris Warfield, Elizabeth Saxon
plot: A woman who never got over the fact that her father abandoned her as a child tracks him down with only one desire - to ruin his life just as he ruined hers. A tragic incestuous game of deceit and seduction begins.
